# Version 4.156.0
> **Skia m156 and GTK4 rendering** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.156.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews Skia m156 and adds GPU rendering for GTK4 applications. GTK4 gains a GL-backed canvas and high-density raster painting. Linux NoDependencies restores installed-font discovery, and WebAssembly packages select matching native archives for .NET 11. Tizen applications now require Tizen 10.

## Breaking Changes

- **Tizen packages require Tizen 10** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp native-assets packages now target net10.0-tizen10.0 and support x64 and arm64. Tizen 8 and 9 are no longer supported by these builds. Retarget applications to Tizen 10 and .NET 10; source builders need the Tizen 10 SDK and GCC 14.2 toolchain. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
- **GTK4 raster painting defaults to physical pixels** — SKDrawingArea now allocates its backing surface at the display scale factor and exposes physical-pixel CanvasSize and paint Info by default. Set IgnorePixelScaling to true to retain logical painting coordinates with full-resolution backing; RawInfo remains physical and GTK input coordinates remain logical. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Engine

- **Skia milestone 156** — Updates the bundled engine to chrome/m156 without changing the managed core API or adding native C API functions. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.100 while its native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.4.0. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247))

## API Surface

- **GTK4 GL canvas** — Adds SKGLArea with PaintSurface, CanvasSize, GRContext, an opt-in render loop, and IgnorePixelScaling. GTK owns the GL context; use QueueRender to invalidate. Manually bundled GTK runtimes must include libepoxy for GL dispatch. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Bug Fixes

- **Installed fonts in Linux NoDependencies** — Restores directory-backed default font discovery without adding fontconfig. Installed fonts under /usr/share/fonts are available for family matching and shaping again; builds can override the font directory. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))
- **GTK4 raster surface lifetime** — Releases the Skia surface before its Cairo-owned pixels and marks modified pixel storage dirty after the color-channel swizzle. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Platform

- **.NET 11 WebAssembly archives** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now select Emscripten 6.0.2 archives for net11 and later, retaining threading and SIMD variants. net8 continues to use 3.1.34 and net9/net10 use 3.1.56. ([#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306))

## Security

- **Windows native build hardening** — Aligns native builds with matching v143 Spectre CRT libraries and propagates CFG and stack-cookie flags through ANGLE and its third-party compilation. Matching CRT provenance does not imply whole-program Spectre instrumentation. ([#5238](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5238))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100

HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100 retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0. Its WebAssembly packages select Emscripten 6.0.2 for .NET 11 and later, Tizen packages require Tizen 10, and Windows native builds use matching v143 Spectre CRT libraries.
